pictures.name: CFR1-Assisi-Party
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A medieval Italian hill town, Assisi, around 1200: a torch-lit stone piazza at night, pink-stone houses climbing the hill. In the middle, Francis, a slim young Italian man of about twenty-four with short dark hair and a thin short beard, bright dark eyes, in a bright embroidered silk tunic and a feathered cap, raises a cup and laughs among a crowd of richly dressed young friends at a long table of food and wine, a lute player beside them. Warm gold torchlight, deep blue night sky. Merriment, wealth, youth. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CFR2-Prison-Change

His fine cloak lies forgotten on the floor. Deep blue shadows, one shaft of gold light. Stillness, the beginning of change. Gentle, no injury. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CFR3-Giving-Away
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A cloth merchant’s shop in medieval Assisi, bolts of red, blue and gold cloth stacked on shelves. In the middle, Francis, a slim young Italian man of about twenty-four with short dark hair and a thin short beard, bright dark eyes, in a plain tunic, hands a folded bolt of fine blue cloth and a small purse to a poor old woman in a patched shawl, smiling. In the shop doorway behind, his father, a heavy-set wealthy merchant with a grey beard in a rich crimson velvet robe, has just walked in, face furious. Warm gold light from the street, deep blue shadows inside. Generosity meeting anger. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CFR4-Before-Bishop
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The stone piazza before the bishop’s house in Assisi, by day, a crowd of townspeople watching. In the middle, Francis, a slim young Italian man of about twenty-four with short dark hair and a thin short beard, bright dark eyes, seen from behind, wrapped modestly from shoulders to knees in the bishop’s large brown cloak, as the bishop of Assisi, a kind older man in a white mitre and a gold-embroidered cope, folds the cloak around him. To one side, his father, a heavy-set wealthy merchant with a grey beard in a rich crimson velvet robe, holds a neat folded pile of fine clothes and a purse, turning away, stunned. Warm gold daylight, deep blue shadows under the arches. Surrender, freedom, tenderness. Fully modest. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CFR5-Leper-Kiss
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A dusty country road below Assisi, cypress trees and olive groves. Francis, a slim young Italian man of about twenty-four with short dark hair and a thin short beard, bright dark eyes, in a plain good brown riding cloak, has climbed down from a horse and kneels to gently kiss the hand of a poor man in a worn grey hooded cloak, a dignified weathered face, who looks at him in astonishment, his hands lightly wrapped in clean linen. The horse waits behind. Soft gold afternoon light, deep blue shade under the trees. The two men in the middle. Compassion, tenderness, dignity. Gentle, no sores, no injury. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CFR6-Brothers-Road
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. An Umbrian hillside at sunset, Assisi on its hill in the distance. Francis, a slim young Italian man of about twenty-four with short dark hair and a thin short beard, bright dark eyes, a little older, in a rough grey-brown hooded tunic tied with a knotted rope, barefoot, walks a dirt road with arms open toward the golden sun, a handful of companions in the same rough tunics walking with him, one carrying a basket of bread. A pale moon rising in the deep blue eastern sky. Joy, simplicity, freedom. No text, no letters, no logos.
